raw_html: [[Greater Dispelling Guard|Greater Dispelling Guard]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Greater Dispelling Guard]]:''' This item is infused with a power that purges out the magical energies of those that strike the wearer. When the wearer is hit in melee it will apply a Greater Dispel Magic effect to the attacker, stripping away its protective spells.
